name: When should I consider repairing a window versus replacing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing a window versus replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the extent of the damage and the window's overall condition. If the issue is minor, such as a faulty latch, a broken balance, or a simple obstruction, repair is usually more cost-effective. However, if the window has extensive frame rot, severe drafts, broken glass, or multiple malfunctioning components, replacement might be the better long-term solution. Also, consider the age of your windows; older, inefficient windows might justify replacement for energy savings. A professional assessment can help determine the best course.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is suitable for minor issues like latches or balances, while replacement is better for extensive damage, rot, or very old, inefficient windows.
